title: Classification of Six-dimensional Real Nilpotent Lie Bialgebras of Symplectic Type and their Poisson-Lie Groups
summary: In this paper, we classify all six-dimensional real nilpotent Lie bialgebras of symplectic type. The Poisson structures on all of the related six-dimensional Poisson-Lie groups are obtained. Some new integrable Hamiltonian systems for which the Poisson-Lie group plays the role of a phase space and its dual Lie group plays the role of a symmetry group of the system are obtained.
